title_fa: شخصیتِ برند: تصویرِ هوش مصنوعی از شخصیت (FLUX روی ComfyUI)
note: brandchar.render runs on the node's own ComfyUI with the FLUX image-edit profile (flux-edit-balanced / flux-edit-preserve from upmarket_comfyui_flask/profiles.json): the code-drawn character is the reference picture (img2img), so nothing new has to be installed besides what the owner already has - ComfyUI and a FLUX checkpoint. The only item is a check: it passes when the profile exists and a FLUX checkpoint file is found next to ComfyUI (NM_COMFYUI_DIR overrides the place). While it fails, brandchar.render jobs WAIT in the site's durable queue (they are never lost) and the panel shows this line; FLUX packages are offered under 'Models' (packages flux-common + flux-dev, FLUX.1 [dev] Non-Commercial licence: owner's choice, never automatic). IP-Adapter / PuLID are only detected and reported (caps.brandchar.identity_tools). Stdlib only.

items.title: FLUX image-edit profile + checkpoint are present for ComfyUI
